The 'Power of Suggestion' is very strong in our culture. You are partly under a 'spell' of your own fear.
Don't touch it with your bare hands! Use a nylon and pour anointing oil on it.
Is she beautiful enough to be worth the Juju? (Just kidding, leave!).
Record a video of the calabash as evidence before you destroy it. For the 'Gram' or for the police.
Truth and Light will always overcome darkness. Stand firm.
Does she have a 'spiritual mother' she visits? That's usually the source.
You are a grown man. Shake it off. Use your logic.
Nigeria is a wild place. Stay prayerful and stay woke.
if she asks why you're leaving, say 'the oracle said we are not compatible.'
The placebo effect works in reverse too. Believe you are free, and you will be.
lol 'Virtuous Woman' with a side of voodoo. typical Lagos packaging.
Superstition is a social tool for managing uncertainty. She is using it to manage you.
Check your bank statement. How much have you really lost to this 'Virtue'?
Your family will always forgive you. Go home.
I'm packing my bags now. She's at a 'vigil.' I'm not waiting.
Good move. Don't look back. Don't even block her yet, just vanish.
Check your pockets for any 'seeds' or 'threads' she might have hidden there.
The bird has found the open cage. Fly.
if you see a black cat on your way out, keep going. it's just a cat.
Holy Ghost Fire! Be safe, my child.
Statistically, most 'love charms' are just herbs and drama. You'll be fine.
imagine if the calabash starts ringing like a phone. lol. okay, i'll stop.
Post the video on WhisprSpace! We want to see the voodoo.
Change your phone number and your workplace if possible.
The peace you feel when you leave is the real miracle.
Don't forget to take your original documents. She might use them for more Juju.
Welcome back to the real world, bro.
I’m out. I’m at a hotel. I feel lighter already. Thank God.

title: I just inherited a house in Banana Island but I’m currently a gatekeeper in Ajah.
content: My late father, who I never met, was a billionaire. His lawyers found me yesterday. I’m a high school dropout and I’ve been opening gates for 10 years. Now I have a mansion worth 2 billion naira. I don't know how to speak 'big grammar,' I don't know how to use a fork and knife, and I’m terrified the rich neighbors will look at me like a cockroach. Should I sell it and go back to my village or try to fit in?

replies.content: sell it? are you okay? you are now a 'Banana Island Big Boy.' hire a tutor to teach you English and a chef to cook for you. enjoy your father's money!
bruh, this is a Nollywood movie in real life. don't sell! stay there and let them look at u. their look can't reduce your bank balance lol.
This is 'sudden wealth syndrome' mixed with 'imposter syndrome.' You need a wealth manager and a therapist, not a bus ticket to the village.
The maintenance cost of a house in Banana Island is higher than your current annual salary. You need to sell some assets to create a trust fund for the bills.
Can I be your new gatekeeper? I have experience! lol. But seriously, keep the house.
Your father’s legacy is yours by right. Character is not about the fork you use, it’s about the heart you have.
The neighbors will judge you anyway. Even if you were a PhD holder, they’d find something. Just be a 'rich' cockroach.
God has lifted you from the dunghill! Don't look back. Just be humble and learn.
If you sell it, the money will finish. If you keep the land, your children will never be gatekeepers.
The mountain doesn't care who climbs it, it's still a mountain. You have reached the peak. Stay there.
if you need a 'hype man' to follow you to meetings, call me. I'll make you look like a tech mogul.
no cap, just start wearing sunglasses everywhere. people will think u r a mysterious genius lol.
Class is a social construct. Wealth is a mathematical reality. Focus on the math.
I can teach you how to use a fork and knife for 50k a session. (Just kidding, use YouTube).
Is there a pool? Invite us for a 'House Warming' for the Ajah boys!
Be careful of 'new' friends and relatives who will suddenly appear. They are more dangerous than the neighbors.
The transition from 'Gatekeeper' to 'Homeowner' is a massive psychological leap. Take it slow.
Sell it and buy 10 houses in Ajah. You'll be the king of Ajah and still have 1 billion left.
Banana Island is boring anyway. Everyone is hiding behind high walls.
Hire the same lawyers to protect your interests. Don't sign anything yet.
if a neighbor complains about your grammar, tell them your money speaks for you. it's the universal language.
You need an estate manager. You cannot mow that lawn yourself.
imagine the girls in Ajah when they hear u moved to Banana Island. shege pro max lol.
Institutionalize your wealth. Real estate, stocks, bonds. Don't just sit in the mansion.
I hope you have a nice car to park in that garage. A bicycle won't look good there.
Wisdom is profitable to direct. Seek counsel from successful men with good character.
I walked into the house today and I started crying. The bathroom is bigger than my whole room in Ajah.
Don't cry in the bathroom, cry in the Jacuzzi! Enjoy it, man.
This is the 'Nigerian Dream.' From 'Oga' to 'Chairman.'
Use your money to build a school in your village. That's real success.
if you sell, you're a fool. hold that land. Banana Island land never depreciates.
Security: You are now a target for kidnappers. Hire professional security immediately.
lol 'big grammar.' just say 'Indeed' and 'Absolutely' to everything. u'll be fine.
The social mobility you've experienced is statistically rare. Document your journey.
Can I borrow 5k? (Just testing your billionaire status). lol.
Lagos is a crazy place. One day u r a gatekeeper, next day u r the Landlord.
Don't change your personality, just change your clothes. Stay real.
Read books. Watch documentaries. Catch up on the years you missed.
Sell it and move to Canada. Why stay in this Lagos heat?
The sun is finally shining on your side of the street. Don't close the curtains.
if you need a private driver, I know a guy. He's very discreet.
God bless your father's soul for remembering you. It's a miracle.
imagine if u meet Davido at the gym lol. 'What's up, neighbor?'
Philanthropy is a good way to gain social acceptance in high-status circles.
Don't forget the Ajah boys! Bring some bread when you visit.
Humility will take you further than money ever could.
I’m keeping the house. I’ve decided to hire a teacher. I want to make my father proud.
That's the spirit! Welcome to the 1%.
I'm so happy for you. This made my day.
Keep us updated. We want to hear about your first day as a billionaire.

title: I found out my 'Yahoo Boy' brother is using my name for his scams.
content: My brother just bought a house in Lekki. He says he’s doing 'Freelancing.' Today, I opened a letter addressed to me and found a fake ID with my face and name, but with 'CEO of a Gold Export Company' as the title. He’s been using my identity to receive wire transfers from his victims in the US. If the EFCC comes, they are coming for ME. He says he's 'protecting the family' by making money. How do I stop this without sending him to jail?

replies.content: he's not protecting you, he's using you as a human shield. if EFCC hits, he'll run and you'll be in Kirikiri. stop him now.
Identity theft is a serious felony. You are legally implicated. You need to report the documents as 'stolen' or 'compromised' to the police immediately to create a paper trail.
bruh, 'Freelancing' in Lekki is the code for Yahoo lol. but using your face is a low blow. he's wildin.
This is 'parasitic sibling dynamics.' He is externalizing the risk of his criminal activities onto you while internalizing the rewards.
Evil is evil, even if it's done by your own blood. You cannot sacrifice your freedom for his greed.
Ask him for 50% of the money since you're the 'CEO.' lol. (Don't do this, it's evidence).
EFCC is not joking these days. They will pick you up at 4am and your brother will be in a club in Dubai.
Blood of Jesus! Why would he do this to his own sister? Please, talk to your parents.
If you tell your parents, they'll probably tell you to 'manage' it because he's the breadwinner. Nigeria is a mess.
A bridge that is built with stolen stones will collapse on everyone crossing it. Get off the bridge.
burn the fake ID. take a video of it burning. keep the video as proof that you destroyed it.
no cap, if he has your face on a 'Gold Export' ID, he's already deep in the game. you are a target.
The 'survival' narrative he’s using is a manipulation tactic to keep you silent.
If you don't act, you are an accomplice. The law doesn't care about 'sibling love.'
How did he even get your photo for the ID? Check your own house for hidden cameras.
This is why I moved out of my family house. Too much 'agbado' business.
Report the account he's using to the bank. It's better to lose the money than your life.
He's putting a target on your back for $1000. That's not love.
Lagos is full of 'Gold Exporters' who have never seen real gold. Stay safe.
I hope you have a good lawyer on speed dial. You're going to need one.
if he buys you a gift, don't accept it. it's 'proceeds of crime.'
Forensic accounting can trace those wire transfers back to your identity in minutes.
lol 'CEO of Gold.' next week he'll make u 'Sultan of Oil.' bruh.
The ethical dilemma here is profound, but self-preservation must win.
I lost my brother to the Yahoo life. He's in prison now. It started just like this.
Tell him you're going to the EFCC if he doesn't stop. Watch how fast he moves the money.
I’m terrified. He’s my only brother. My parents are late. I don't want to lose him.
You’ve already lost him to greed. Now you’re just protecting a ghost.
Lagos boys and the search for 'fast' wealth... it's a curse.
The FBI might even get involved if the victims are Americans. This is serious.
if you stay in that house he bought, you're enjoying the crime. move out.
Anonymously tip off the bank about the fraudulent activity on your identity.
imagine being in a cell while he's eating at Shiro. bruh, don't be a fall guy.
He is exploiting your emotional bond for criminal logistics.
Take the fake IDs and hide them in a safe place. They are your leverage.
Change your legal name? lol. No, just stop him.
The 'Gold' business in Lagos is 99% scam. Everyone knows this.
He is not 'protecting the family,' he is destroying it from the inside.
I bet he spends more on 'soap' and 'sacrifices' than on real business.
Darkness cannot be used to paint a bright future.
if he doesn't stop by Monday, call the police. family or not.
God have mercy on this generation. We have lost our way.
lol 'CEO of Gold' is a crazy title. he didn't even try to be subtle.
The lack of digital privacy in Nigeria makes identity theft incredibly easy.
He's a narcissist. He thinks he can't get caught.
Give him a 24-hour ultimatum to shut everything down.
The truth is a hard pill, but it cures the disease.
I'm so glad I'm an only child right now.
Stay safe, sister. Don't let his choices become your chains.
I confronted him. He laughed and said 'the game is the game.' I’m going to the police tomorrow. Wish me luck.

title: My 'Tech' boss is paying our salaries in 'Company Tokens' instead of Naira.
content: I work for a Web3 startup in Yaba. For the last two months, the CEO said 'liquidity is tight' so he’s paying us in $WHISPR tokens. He says by December, the token will 'moon' and we will all be billionaires. I can't pay my landlord with tokens. My mama is asking for money for her meds and I can't send her 'crypto.' Is this even a real job or am I in a cult?

replies.content: you're in a 'ponzi startup.' if he can't pay Naira, he doesn't have a business. he has a gambling addiction. run.
bruh, $WHISPR to the moon? the only thing mooning is his audacity lol. leave now.
This is 'speculative wage theft.' He is shifting the financial risk of his failed venture onto the employees.
Labor laws in Nigeria explicitly require payment in legal tender. Tokens are not legal tender. You have a legal claim for unpaid wages.
Ask him if he's paying his own rent in tokens. I bet his landlord wants Naira too! lol.
A man who promises future millions while you starve today is a deceiver. Don't follow a blind guide.
Yaba tech bros will finish us. Every week, a new 'token' that solves no problems.
I worked for a guy like this. The token went to zero and he disappeared to London. Get out.
Oh dear, tokens for medicine? That’s not right at all. God will provide a real job for you.
You are sowing your time in a field made of paper. The first rain will wash it away.
if he mentions 'blockchain' one more time, slap him with your resignation letter.
no cap, the 'moon' is just a way to keep u working for free. the 'liquidity' is in his pocket.
Web3 in Nigeria is 10% innovation and 90% regulatory arbitrage and scams.
Can you swap the tokens for USDT at least? If not, it's just a digital sticker.
I’m a developer. If my boss tried this, I’d delete the repo and block him. Respect your skill.
The 'moon' he's talking about is probably just the light from the security guard's torch.
Is the token even listed on an exchange? If not, it's literally worthless.
He's a 'Visionary' who can't see his own bank balance. Classic Yaba.
Don't let 'tech enthusiasm' blind you to financial reality. You are an employee, not an investor.
Ask for your back-pay in Naira or threaten to go to the Labor Ministry.
if he says 'WAGMI' (We Are All Gonna Make It), just know you are NOT making it.
The opportunity cost of staying at this 'startup' is increasing every day.
lol $WHISPR. sounds like a secret u shouldn't tell anyone. like 'I don't have a job.'
This is a digital version of the 'company store' model from the 19th century.
I told him I need Naira and he said I have a 'poverty mindset.' I'm so angry.
A 'poverty mindset' is what you get when you don't get paid. He's a clown.
Take all the company laptops as 'collateral' and leave.
Pride goes before a fall. His token fall will be spectacular.
Lagos is too expensive for 'experimental' salaries. Move to a fintech that has real VC money.
If you are 'early' to a scam, you're a victim. If you are 'late,' you're a bag holder.
tell him you'll pay for your coffee in 'company vibes.' see if the barista accepts it.
This is a major red flag for insolvency. The company is already dead.
no cap, he probably used the Naira for salaries to buy a 'Bored Ape' NFT lol.
Web3 'evangelists' often use jargon to mask basic labor exploitation.
He is gaslighting you with the 'moon' talk. It's a psychological trap.
I hope you have a copy of your contract. (You probably don't, it's Yaba).
Quit. Now. Every day you stay is a day you're paying to work there.
If the token was actually good, he'd be able to sell it for Naira to pay you.
I’ve seen 50 startups like this in the last year. Only 1 survived. The odds are bad.
The sky is full of stars, but you can't eat them. Find a job on the ground.
if he has a car, key it. (Don't actually, but think about it).
A successful Web3 company pays in USDC or USDT at the very least.
imagine being a 'millionaire' on paper but trekking to work. the peak of Lagos irony.
The 'hustle' narrative is used here to justify illegal compensation practices.
He just posted on LinkedIn about 'Resilience in the Bear Market.' I'm dying.
He’s resilient because he’s eating. You’re the one suffering.
Truth is light. This whole business is in the dark.
Update your resume. Put 'Token Collector' as your job title. lol.
I’m so done with Yaba tech. It’s all just packaging and lies.
See you on the other side. A real job is waiting for you.

title: I'm pretty sure my 'happily married' boss is on a dating app.
content: My boss constantly talks about his 'perfect wife' in meetings and has a family wallpaper on his work laptop. Last weekend I was swiping on a dating app and his face showed up. His profile says he is 'separated' and 'looking for something real.' He works at the same company. I took a screenshot but I don't know what to do with it. Do I tell HR? Tell his wife anonymously? Or just mind my business and act normal on Monday?

replies.content: screenshot is your protection. don't show anyone at work yet. this is a landmine.
His personal life is not your business. Unless he has been inappropriate with you, let it go.
bruh, 'family wallpaper' at the office but 'separated' on the app? the audacity is legendary.
This places you in a complex ethical and professional position. Any action must be carefully calculated.
Don't send the screenshot to anyone yet. Wait. Observe. Some things are not your battle.
Lagos married men on dating apps is the most 'unsurprising surprise' since fuel subsidy removal.
The wife probably already knows or suspects. These things are rarely as hidden as they seem.
Send it to the wife. Anonymously. I would want someone to tell me.
The family wallpaper is clearly cover art. He has been doing press releases with his desktop.
A man who sells peace at home and buys chaos outside will one day lose both.
whatever u do, don't let him know that YOU saw it. that's the dangerous move here.
imagine him swiping and his own staff profile pops up. the universe is a comedian.
Document everything. Screenshot with timestamp. Do not act impulsively.
Think about the wife first. Imagine being her and nobody told you. That's the worst part.
There are anonymous tip services for exactly this kind of disclosure. You don't have to expose yourself.
His mistake was using his real photos. These people are not even smart about it.
Maybe he IS genuinely separated and hasn't told the office yet? Give a small benefit of doubt before you act.
Was he online recently when you saw the profile? Check when he was last active.
This is the kind of info that can get you fired if you're not careful. Think about your job first.
A man's secret is often his weapon. If he finds out you know, you could become a target for downsizing.
the moment you act is the moment you are involved. just make sure you're ready for that.
HR will not thank you. They will manage the situation, which might include managing you out.
lol 'looking for something real.' bro, his real is at home in the wallpaper. this is irony at its peak.
The ethical obligation is to truth, but the practical obligation is to your livelihood. Weigh both.
Send it to the wife anonymously. You don't have to carry this secret. But protect yourself first.
Why do people always want to intervene in other people's marriages? Let adults make their own choices.
nine out of ten Lagos managers are doing this. only one gets caught by their own staff. today is your day.
He's not 'separated.' He's a liar. The wallpaper proves it. Tell the wife.
So during your next appraisal, do you bring up the app or the KPIs first? Asking for a friend.
Secrets typed on a phone at midnight have a way of finding daylight.
if he's a good boss, this info is a burden. if he's a bad boss, it's power. which is he?
every time he says 'we value family here' in a meeting, u will have to hold your face. tough life.
Your professional relationship must remain intact regardless of what you choose to do with this.
A WhatsApp anonymous message to the wife is an option. Many people handle it this way.
Create a throwaway email and forward the screenshot to her. No trace back to you.
Carrying this alone will affect your peace at work. Do something or make peace with doing nothing.
Imagine if the wife is also on the app and they find each other. That's God handling it without you.
Did he like anyone you know? That would make this a whole different kind of story.
I've been in this situation. I stayed quiet. He got caught by someone else eventually. Save yourself the stress.
The family wallpaper is basically the disclaimer he forgot to update. Classic Lagos.
The wife may not want to know. Some marriages run on 'don't ask don't tell.' You don't know her situation.
bro, the algorithm really just delivered drama straight to your timeline. God is watching everything.
If you choose to tell the wife, do it purely from empathy, not from a desire to cause disruption.
You took a screenshot. You are already involved. Now decide how involved you want to be.
honestly in Nigeria, just keep your head down. office drama has derailed better careers than yours.
If it were your marriage, you'd be BEGGING someone to tell you. Send the info.
There is no clean answer here. Every option has a cost. Choose the cost you can live with.
update us! we need to know what happens lol this is too good.
I just deleted my boss from my 'people you may know' suggestions. not taking any chances. lol.
whatever you decide, don't overthink it so long it eats you. decide and move forward.

title: Is it wrong to regret having kids?
content: I'm going to say what most parents are too afraid to say. I love my children but I regret having them. Before kids, I was building a career, I had money, I had freedom, I had ME. Now I'm just 'Mama X.' I haven't slept properly in 4 years. I haven't been on a date with my husband in 6 months. Every single kobo goes to school fees and diapers. Is this just exhaustion talking or is the regret real? Am I a terrible person for feeling this way?

replies.content: this is the most honest thing i've read in a long time. the grief of a self that no longer exists is real.
Saying this publicly is brave. Parental regret is real but rarely discussed. You are not alone.
bruh, 4 years of no sleep? that's not a life that's a sentence. your feelings are 100% valid.
Parental regret is a clinically documented phenomenon. It does not make you a bad parent. It makes you human.
A lot of mothers feel exactly this but will never say it. You just said it for all of them.
society sells children as 'the greatest joy' but forgets to mention it also comes with the greatest sacrifice.
The romantic version of motherhood that social media sells is the biggest scam. Reality is brutal.
Nobody talks about the identity loss that comes with becoming a mother. You are still a whole person.
'Mama X.' lol. I know that feeling. you become an address, not a name.
She poured herself into cups for others to drink, and forgot she was thirsty too.
the exhaustion is probably amplifying the regret. they are not the same thing but they feel identical at 2am.
6 months with no date? that's not a marriage that's a co-parenting arrangement. something needs to change.
A conversation with your husband about restoring your individual identity is long overdue.
Postpartum depression can last for years and look exactly like 'regret.' Please speak to a doctor before deciding anything.
Studies show women report higher rates of parental regret than men, due to unequal burden distribution at home.
Who is helping you? Because if you're doing this alone, the regret is actually exhaustion wearing a costume.
This phase passes. But you have to fight for yourself while it's here. Don't disappear into 'Mama X.'
What did your life look like before kids that you miss the most? Genuinely asking.
I asked myself this exact question at 3am breastfeeding my second child. 5 years later I'm glad I said it out loud.
There is no 'wrong' emotion. Denying it is what causes damage. You are doing the right thing by voicing this.
the question is not 'am i terrible' but 'what do i need?' those are very different questions.
society built a system where mothers must perform joy or be seen as monsters. that system is the problem, not you.
every school fees payment is a piece of a dream deferred. i understand this more than i want to.
What is ONE small thing you can reclaim this week just for yourself? Start there. Just one.
Your children need a mother who is whole, not a mother who is a martyr. Take care of yourself guilt-free.
Regret is not the same as not loving them. Hold both truths at once. It's hard but it's real.
Nigerian women are expected to dissolve completely into motherhood. No wonder there's nothing left of you.
I regret some days. Not them. There's a difference that took me years to understand.
'Mama X' is not your final form. She is just your current role. You still exist inside there.
She loves them fiercely and yet mourns the woman she left at the hospital. Both things are true.
have you told your husband any of this? or is he operating like everything is fine?
4 years without proper sleep is actually a human rights issue. where is the husband in all this?
Couples therapy is not just for broken marriages. It's also for tired ones. Consider it seriously.
Countries with mandatory shared parental leave show significantly lower rates of maternal regret. The system is failing you, not the other way around.
Build a system. One babysitter weekend a month. Husband takes night shift two nights a week. Protect your identity by design.
You are not a terrible person. A terrible person would not ask this question. A terrible person would not even care.
One day they will be 18 and you will get yourself back. I know that's far. But it's real and it's coming.
Have you been able to talk to any other mothers about this? Or have you been carrying this in silence?
every parent I know who was honest like this eventually found their way back to themselves. you will too.
the day I became a mum, my first name just retired. lol. not funny but also very funny.
this is a grief post, not a regret post. you're grieving a version of yourself that still exists, just buried.
Parenthood is sold as a 'completion' but it can also be a subtraction if we're not careful. Honest post.
real talk, half the parents posting 'I wouldn't change it for the world' are also crying alone at 2am.
The first step is acknowledging what you've lost, then working systematically to recover what's recoverable.
This is not regret. This is a boundary violation that's been happening for 4 years and nobody has named it.
your body, your career, your sleep, your money, your identity — motherhood takes everything and says 'be grateful.'
I wrote a journal entry like this once. Then I got therapy. Then I got a babysitter. Then I got myself back. It works.
A mother who admits this is stronger than ten mothers who smile through the pain.
we want an update. we are rooting for you to find YOU again. not 'Mama X.' YOU.
I'm booking a solo trip right now because of this post. thank you. we're all going to be ok lol.

title: I’m a 'Lagos Agbero' but I have a BSc in Architecture. I make more money from the 'Garage' than I ever did in an office.
content: Life is funny. I graduated with a 2:1 from ABU. I worked for 3 years at a firm in Ikeja for 70k a month. My boss would insult my generation every day. One day, I quit and followed my childhood friend to the garage. Now, I collect 'dues' from yellow buses. On a good day, I take home 15k. That’s 450k a month. I wear my white architecture shirts to the garage to annoy my old boss. Am I wasting my brain or just winning at life?

replies.content: you're a 'Strategic Agbero.' if the system won't pay you for your brain, take their money for your presence. 450k is 450k. period.
bruh, 450k to just shout 'Owa!' and collect money? u r winning lol. architecture is for people with rich fathers.
This is a classic case of 'underemployment due to systemic economic failure.' You've optimized for cash flow over professional prestige.
You are wasting your long-term potential for short-term liquidity. The garage has no 'Senior Architect' level. You will hit a ceiling soon.
Wear a hard hat and a safety vest to the garage. Tell them you're 'building' the economy. lol.
A man’s dignity is in his work. If you are extorting people, you are losing your soul, no matter the amount.
It's not 'extortion,' it's 'informal logistics management.' I keep the peace in the garage.
Oh my, a BSc holder in the garage? It’s a pity. But 450k is a lot of money for a young man.
I respect the hustle. Architecture in Nigeria is a scam unless you have your own firm. Stay in the garage and save.
The ink on your degree is dry, but the Naira in your hand is fresh. Feed yourself first.
use that 450k to start your own design firm on the side. the garage is your 'investor.'
no cap, some of those agberos have more houses than the people they collect money from. be like them.
The 'Informal Economy' is the real engine of Lagos. You've just switched gears.
I bet you can draw a perfect 3D model of the garage. lol.
What happens when the 'Union' comes for their cut? You're not at the top of the food chain yet.
Lagos is the only place where a graduate and a tout share the same office (the road).
I’m an engineer and I’m thinking of joining you. 70k is just an insult.
Don't let the 'Agbero' life consume your personality. Remember who you were at ABU.
If you marry a girl, will you tell her you're an Architect or an Agbero?
Both. He's an 'Architect of the Streets.' lol.
if the garage gets raided, use your 'big grammar' to confuse the police. it works.
You are contributing to the high cost of transportation in Lagos. You're part of the problem.
bruh, the 'problem' is the government not paying 450k for an architect. don't blame the hustle.
There is a sociological fascination in 'elite' individuals entering 'low-status' high-yield professions.
Does your mom know? Mothers usually want the 'BSc' title more than the money.
Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished. Work with your hands and your mind for good.
My mom is happy because I bought her a new freezer. She doesn't care about the 'BSc' title anymore.
Freeze her some small chops with that money! lol.
Is there a retirement plan in the garage? What happens when you're 50?
By 50, he'll be a 'Union Chairman' or a politician. That's the path.
don't ever go back to that 70k job. that was the real crime.
The lack of professional development will hurt you if you ever try to Japa.
lol who wants to japa when u r making 450k? london is cold and u'll be washing plates.
This is a form of 'social resistance' against exploitative corporate structures.
The 'Garage' is a dangerous place. One day a fight will break out and your BSc won't save you.
Carry your T-square for self-defense. lol.
I bet your old boss is still looking for a 'cheap' architect to insult.
Tell him you're the 'Principal Architect' of the Oshodi Terminal.
I respect the courage. Most of us are too scared of what people will say.
A diamond in the mud is still a diamond. Just don't forget how to shine.
collect that money, save it, buy land, and then build your own mansion using your BSc.
Make sure you're paying tax on that 450k. (Just kidding, nobody does).
imagine if u meet your old classmates in traffic while u r collecting money. lol.
The 'hustle' culture is a double-edged sword for the educated youth.
I admire your honesty. Nigeria is not for the weak.
May your path lead you back to your true calling one day.
My 'true calling' is not being broke. And for now, the garage is answering.
Good luck, Chairman. See you in the garage.
I'm coming to join you on Monday. I have a BSc in Geology. lol.
The 'Graduate Agbero' club is growing. We need a WhatsApp group.

title: I’m 'Soft Launching' my new boyfriend on IG but my 'Ex' who I still live with is stalking my stories.
content: Lagos is the capital of 'Living with your Ex' because rent is too high. We broke up 6 months ago but the lease ends in December. I have a new guy now. I posted a picture of 'his hand and a watch' at dinner last night. My ex, who was in the other room, sent me a DM saying 'Nice watch, but he looks like he can't afford the bill.' How do I move on when my past is literally in the kitchen making Indomie?

replies.content: this is the ultimate Lagos shege. your ex is a 'roommate from hell.' just block him on IG even if you're in the same house.
bruh, 'making Indomie' while u r soft launching? that's a cinematic masterpiece lol. tell him to mind his noodles.
This is 'forced proximity post-separation.' It’s a significant source of emotional stress and prevents closure.
Post a picture of your new guy's shoes next. Tell your ex 'At least he doesn't trek to the kitchen.' lol.
Lagos rent will make you stay with your enemy for 12 months. It's a survival tactic, not a choice.
Focus on the future. December is coming. Don't engage with his bitterness.
Why is he even checking your stories? He’s clearly not over you.
Oh dear, this is very awkward. Can't you stay with a friend until December?
I’ve been there. I had to cook in my room using a camp gas just to avoid him. It’s hard.
A house with two hearts that don't beat together is just a box of air. Breathe outside.
if he sends another DM, reply 'The Indomie is burning.' keep it short.
no cap, 'soft launching' while living with an ex is brave. u r a legend lol.
The 'Social Media Performance' of your new life is triggering his 'Status Anxiety.'
Does the new guy know you live with your ex? That's the real question.
He knows. He calls it 'Extreme Lagos Living.' He’s cool with it, mostly.
December is just a few months away. Start packing slowly to show him u r really leaving.
Lagos real estate agents are the real reason for this drama. 2 years rent up front is a crime.
Your ex is acting like a 'hater' because he’s losing his 'territory.'
Invite the new guy over! Let’s see how the ex handles 'Hard Launch' in the parlor.
That’s a recipe for a fight. Don't do it.
put a password on your phone. he probably peeks at your notifications while u r in the shower.
Conflict resolution is impossible in this environment. You need a physical barrier.
imagine if the new guy and the ex start a 'gym' rivalry in the living room lol.
Living with an ex is a form of 'prolonged emotional exposure therapy' you didn't ask for.
Ask him to pay for the watch since he's such an expert on finances. lol.
God will give you the strength to endure until your lease is up.
Lagos life is just 90% stress and 10% 'vibes.'
Why don't you guys just partition the house with a curtain? Very Lagos style.
He’s just jealous. Ignore him and enjoy your new 'hand and watch.'
The 'watch' comment is so petty. He's hurting.
if he talks about the watch again, ask him when he's paying his share of the light bill.
The legal reality of co-tenancy in Nigeria is a mess. You are stuck.
lol 'Soft launching' is basically 'Hate-testing' your ex. and he passed! he hates it.
Jealousy is the shadow of a love that didn't die but was forced to move to the other room.
I did this once. My ex ended up dating my new guy's sister. Lagos is a small village.
Stop posting on your main story. Use 'Close Friends' for the new guy.
Your mental health is more important than IG clout. Take a break from posting.
I hope you have a lock on your bedroom door.
The Indomie comment made me hungry. lol.
The sun sets even on the longest day. December will come.
if he keeps stalking, tag him in the next post. 'Ex-roommate approved.' lol.
Don't be mean. Just be silent. Silence is a powerful answer.
bruh, imagine the tension when the electricity goes out and u both have to find the torch lol.
The 'Lagos Housing Crisis' is the real villain in this relationship story.
I bet he still expects you to buy him detergent. Tell him to use his 'hater' energy to wash his clothes.
Stay focused on your journey. Don't let his comments derail your new happiness.
Lagos is the only place where you can be 'Single' and 'Living with family' (an ex) at the same time.
He just walked past me and sighed loudly. I'm going to my room. Thanks guys.
Hang in there. You're doing great.
I want to see the watch too! lol. Stay safe.

title: I’m 'Lactose Intolerant' but my Mother-in-Law thinks I’m just 'faking it' to avoid her cooking.
content: She came from the village and she loves making creamy soups and porridges with milk. I’ve explained several times that milk makes me sick. She says 'in our village, nobody has this English sickness.' Yesterday, she 'tested' me by putting milk in the Egusi soup and didn't tell me. I spent the whole night in the bathroom. Now she says it’s 'psychological' and I’m just trying to 'insult her kitchen.' How do I survive this visit?

replies.content: she's 'biological warfare' in an Ankara wrapper. show her the medical report, and if that doesn't work, let her wash your clothes after the next 'test.'
bruh, 'English sickness' lol. our parents think anything they can't see on an X-ray is a lie. stay away from the kitchen!
This is 'nutritional gaslighting.' She is prioritizing her ego as a caregiver over your objective physical health.
Technically, many West Africans are lactose intolerant, but they just 'manage' the symptoms or use fermented dairy. It’s a real biological fact.
Give her a 'village' excuse. Tell her a 'prophet' said you shouldn't eat milk or you'll lose your job. she'll believe that one! lol.
Honesty with love. Tell your husband to speak to his mother. It’s his duty to protect you.
If you don't stand your ground, she'll start 'testing' you with other things. Today it's milk, tomorrow it's 'obeying' her.
Oh my, milk in Egusi? That’s not even a village recipe! She’s really trying you.
I have the same issue. My MIL said I’m 'delicate like a flower.' I told her 'Yes, and this flower needs a private toilet.' lol.
A bridge that is made of milk will melt in the rain. Your body is the rain. Don't cross it.
if she puts milk in the food again, pour the food away in front of her. set boundaries with fire.
no cap, 'English sickness' is a top-tier Nigerian mom insult. u can't win the argument lol.
The generational gap in medical awareness is a significant source of domestic conflict in Africa.
I bet she thinks 'Gluten-free' is a cult. lol.
Buy your own food and eat it in your room. If she asks why, say 'I'm fasting for your long life.'
The 'testing' is the worst part. She's literally poisoning you to prove a point.
Where is your husband in all this? He should be the one talking to her.
Lagos life is hard enough without having 'toilet issues' because of Egusi.
I hope you have enough toilet paper. You're going to need it.
Explain to her that the 'anointing' doesn't cover dairy. lol.
next time she cooks, buy her a bottle of Malt and tell her to drink that instead. leave the milk for the cats.
The prevalence of lactase non-persistence in the Yoruba and Igbo populations is quite high. It's not 'English.'
imagine being in a meeting in Lekki and the 'village milk' starts calling u. bruh... the shame.
The culinary pride of the older generation is often a barrier to modern health considerations.
My MIL did this with 'pepper.' I can't eat spicy food. She said I'm 'weak.' I ended up in the ER.
Tell her you're doing a 'keto' diet. People in the village love 'new' sounding things.
Please, take some Imodium. And stay safe.
A soft answer turns away wrath, but a firm 'No' saves your stomach.
Lagos is the land of 'Vibes and Insha Allah,' but your stomach is not a 'Vibe.'
She’s not just 'testing' the food, she’s testing your authority in your own house.
if she cooks again, ask her to eat it first. watch her face.
Digestive health is the foundation of overall well-being. Don't compromise it.
lol 'psychological' diarrhea. some moms should be comedians.
The 'Village' vs 'City' dynamic is a constant theme in Nigerian social anthropology.
I told her I’m calling the doctor. She said the doctor is also 'English.' I give up.
Maybe buy her some 'Lactaid' and tell her it's 'Special Village Sugar'? lol.
Just cook for yourself. If she gets angry, let her be angry. You are the one suffering.
Is she leaving soon? If not, move into a hotel. lol.
I feel for you. Nigerian MILs are a special breed.
Your body is a temple, not a laboratory for her experiments.
if she mentions the village again, tell her the village also has graveyard. for people who didn't listen to their bodies.
I'll pray for her to have understanding! And for your stomach to heal.
imagine if u 'tested' her with something she doesn't like lol. 'Oh, I thought you were faking your dislike for sushi!'
Intergenerational communication requires patience, but physical safety is non-negotiable.
Is the milk even fresh? Lagos 'milk' can be anything.
Set your boundaries with dignity. You are a wife, not a child.
Lactose intolerance is actually the 'original' state of adult humans. She's the 'weird' one for being able to digest it! lol.
Don't let her win. Your health comes first.
I hope your husband grows a spine and tells her to stop.
He finally spoke to her. She’s sulking in the parlor now, but at least the soup is milk-free. Thanks everyone.

title: I’m an 'AI' artist in Lagos and my clients think I’m actually painting with my hands.
content: I use Midjourney and Photoshop to create 'Digital Afro-Futurism.' My clients think I’m spending weeks on a canvas. I charge 500k per piece. Today, one client asked to come to my 'studio' to see me 'work my magic' on her portrait. I don't have a studio, I have a laptop and a bag of plantain chips in my bedroom. If I tell her the truth, I’ll lose the 250k balance. Should I rent a space and a fake easel?

replies.content: rent the space. buy a black turtleneck. put some paint on your forehead. if she asks questions, say 'the soul of the art is in the prompt... i mean, the brush.' lol.
bruh, 'AI' in Lagos is basically 'Magic' lol. don't kill the vibe. just tell her you are a 'minimalist' and work in 'total solitude.'
This is 'technological deception' vs 'creative curation.' You are selling the result, but they are buying the process. It's a classic art market conflict.
Ethics aside, you are charging for a service under false pretenses. Transition to 'Digital Artist' branding immediately to avoid a lawsuit.
Hire someone to pretend to be your 'apprentice' and have them washing brushes while you stare at a blank screen. lol.
A lie cannot be sustained. Eventually, the truth will come out and your reputation will be 'deleted.'
But I spent hours refining the prompts! It’s still my vision, right?
Oh my, 500k for a computer picture? That’s a lot of money. But you should be honest, dear.
I do the same thing for 'copywriting' using ChatGPT. I just tell them I have 'very fast fingers.' lol. Keep the money.
The brush is made of code, but the colors are still your choice. Just don't let the computer take the credit.
if she comes, tell her you work with 'invisible light' and her presence will disturb the 'energy.'
no cap, some of these rich Lekki women just want to feel like they are supporting 'talent.' just give her the show.
The 'Artistic Persona' is often as valuable as the work itself in high-end markets.
Lagos art scene is 90% packaging. If you can package AI as 'Soulful Canvas,' you are a genius.
I’m a real painter and I hate this. We sweat for months while you just type 'woman with gold hair.'
The market decides the value. If people pay 500k, then it's worth 500k.
Tell her your studio is 'under renovation' because of a termite attack. Classic Lagos excuse.
AI is the future. Don't be ashamed. Just be 'Digital.'
I hope you don't get 'Copyright' issues with the images Midjourney uses.
Charge her an extra 100k for the 'Private Viewing' and use it to rent a nice AirBnB for the day. lol.
and hide the plantain chips! buy some expensive cheese and leave it on the table.
Transparency is the best policy for long-term brand equity. Rebrand now.
lol 'Refining the prompts.' bruh, just say u use 'Digital Alchemy.' sounds cooler.
The democratization of art via AI is disrupting traditional hierarchies of skill.
I once sold a 'custom' song I made with AI. The client cried because it was so 'personal.' I felt like a scammer.
If she cries, charge her for the tissues too. lol.
Art is supposed to move people. If your work does that, who cares how it's made?
Integrity matters. If she asks if it's hand-painted, what will you say?
Lagos is the land of 'fake it till you make it.' You've already made it.
I told her I’m a 'Digital Alchemist' and I work in a 'Virtual Studio.' She said it’s 'so innovative' and paid the balance! lol.
see? packaging is everything. go buy more plantain chips with that money.
You've successfully pivoted. Now, actually learn some Photoshop so you can justify the 'Digital' part.
no cap, 'Digital Alchemist' is the best title I’ve heard this year. bruh, u r a genius.
The intersection of tech and art is where the most profit lies currently.
I bet she’s showing her friends her 'Alchemist' portrait right now.
Next time, tell her the AI is actually a 'spirit' that lives in your laptop. lol.
At least you didn't have to rent the fake studio. A win for honesty... mostly.
Still feels like cheating to me. But hey, it's Lagos.
Art has always been about the tools. From charcoal to brushes to AI.
The output is beautiful. That's all that matters to the eye.
get a LinkedIn profile with that title. 'Head of Digital Alchemy.' lol.
I’m glad it worked out! God is good.
Make sure you're using the paid version of the AI tools to avoid legal drama later.
imagine if the AI starts charging u for its 'magic' lol.
Prompt engineering is a legitimate skill, even if the public doesn't understand it yet.
Tell the client u need 'gold plated' prompts for the next one. lol.
I’m proud of you. You adapted and won.
Lagos tech scene is just different.
I'm actually starting to learn how to paint for real now. The money gave me time.
That’s the best ending. Use the AI to fund the soul.

title: I found out my 'Gatekeeper' is actually a Ph.D. holder from a war-torn country.
content: He’s been working for me for 4 years. Very quiet, very polite. Today, I saw him reading a complex book on 'Macroeconomic Theory' in the gatehouse. I asked him why he’s reading such a big book. He smiled and pulled out a folder—he has a Ph.D. in Economics. He fled his country because of the war and his documents aren't recognized here. I’ve been calling him 'Musa' and asking him to wash my car while he probably knows more about the world than I do. I feel so ashamed.

replies.content: this is a 'Hidden Giant.' stop making him wash your car and start asking him for investment advice. and for God's sake, double his salary.
This is 'human capital waste' due to systemic barriers for refugees. He is overqualified for his role, which often leads to a quiet, dignified resignation.
bruh, a Ph.D. in the gatehouse? that's a whole movie plot. Lagos is full of secrets lol. respect him, man.
You should help him get his credentials evaluated by the WES or a similar body. He could be a consultant or a lecturer.
Ask him what he thinks about the Naira vs Dollar situation. He’s probably the best person to ask in the whole street! lol.
Oh, what a humble soul! God will lift him up. Please, treat him with more respect from now on.
Don't just feel ashamed, take action. Introduce him to people who can help him find a real job.
I knew a guy like this who was a surgeon in Syria but worked as a waiter in Lekki. It's heartbreaking.
Is his name even Musa? Maybe you should ask him his real name too.
A star is still a star, even if it's covered by the roof of a gatehouse. Let him shine.
give him a laptop and a good internet connection. he can probably do freelance research for international firms.
no cap, if he's an economist, he probably knows why the fuel price is high lol. ask him for a summary.
The 'dignity of labor' is real, but so is the tragedy of 'missed opportunities' for the economy.
I bet he sees all your 'Big Boy' moves and just shakes his head at the economics of it.
I’m an economist too and I’m struggling. The market is just tough.
Don't fire him though! If you do, he'll be homeless. Just change his role.
Maybe he likes the quiet life? Sometimes people who flee war just want peace.
Lagos is the land of 'one day, things will change.' Maybe today is his day.
Help him write a CV that highlights his skills even if the documents are 'unofficial.'
You are lucky to have such a person around you. Use the opportunity to learn.
if you have children, let him tutor them. he’s better than any lesson teacher you’ll find.
Help him apply for an 'Extraordinary Ability' visa if he wants to move elsewhere.
lol 'Musa the Economist.' i love Lagos. everything is possible.
His resilience is a testament to the human spirit in the face of conflict.
Does he still have to open the gate? Or did you hire a 'Gatekeeper for the Gatekeeper'? lol.
I’m going to go talk to my security man right now. Who knows, maybe he’s a rocket scientist.
Education is something nobody can take from you, even if you lose everything else.
I sat with him for 2 hours today. His name is Dr. Amadou. He was a Dean at his university.
Dr. Amadou! That sounds much better than 'Musa.' Put some respect on his name.
Lagos will humble you. The person you think is 'below' you might be miles ahead.
buy him a nice suit. it’s time for him to leave the gatehouse.
Contact the local University's Economics department. They might have a fellowship for him.
no cap, he’s probably smarter than your boss at work lol.
Refugee integration is a key component of a progressive society.
Did he have a family back home? Maybe you can help him find them.
Ask him for a 'Macroeconomic' forecast for the Christmas period. lol.
This story made me cry. There is so much pain in the world.
But there is also hope. You found him.
I hope he gets back to the lecture hall soon.
The pen is mightier than the gate. He will write a new story.
if you need someone to manage your estate, he’s the one. trust me.
God works in mysterious ways! This is a blessing for you too.
Ensure he has a safe way to receive higher payments without attracting the 'wrong' attention.
lol imagine a burglar trying to enter and the gatekeeper starts explaining the 'Elasticity of Theft.'
His perspective on the Nigerian economy would be uniquely objective.
I bet he’s a fan of Adam Smith. lol.
I’ve officially hired him as my 'Personal Financial Advisor.' He’s moving into the guest room tomorrow.
Yessss! This is the kind of news I love to see on WhisprSpace.
You just did a very noble thing. Dr. Amadou is a lucky man.
A new chapter begins. For both of you.

title: I found out my 'Church' is just a front for a 'Money Laundering' scheme.
content: I’m the accountant for a popular church in Lekki. I noticed that every Monday, we get a 'donation' of 50 million Naira in cash from a 'private donor' who never comes to church. When I asked the Senior Pastor, he told me 'God has many silent partners' and warned me to stop being 'carnally minded.' I’ve seen the same men in black SUVs coming to the office at night. I think I’m working for a cartel. If I quit, I’m dead. If I stay, I’m going to jail. Help.

replies.content: you are in a 'Holy Cartel.' get your documents, make copies, and hide them with a lawyer. then disappear. no job is worth a bullet or a life sentence.
A house of prayer turned into a den of thieves. You must leave, but do it wisely. Do not let them know you suspect anything.
bruh, 50m every Monday? that's a lot of 'grace' lol. but for real, those SUVs don't carry angels. run.
This is 'religious money laundering.' Churches in Nigeria are often used because of their tax-exempt status and lack of financial oversight.
You are a 'whistleblower' in a high-risk environment. Contact the EFCC anonymously via their 'Eagle Eye' app. Do not use your personal phone.
Blood of Jesus! Why are they using the name of the Lord for this? My child, be very careful.
Lagos pastors are some of the richest and most dangerous people. If they find out you know, they'll call it 'spiritual warfare' and end you.
I’ve seen this before. They use the tithes to clean the 'dirty' money. It’s a classic move.
Do you have access to the bank statements? Export them to a cloud drive now.
When the altar is built on blood, the fire will consume the priest and the accountant. Get out.
if the 'silent partners' have black SUVs, they are definitely not from heaven. move to another city.
no cap, 'carnally minded' is the code for 'shut up and take your salary' lol. don't fall for it.
The lack of transparency in religious institutions is a massive loophole in the national anti-money laundering framework.
I’m an accountant too. I’d be shaking. 50m cash is a huge red flag.
Tell them you have a 'family emergency' and you need to travel to the village. Then don't come back.
The 'Pastor' is probably the CEO of the cartel. This is wild.
Is the church building even finished? Or is it a 'permanent' construction site to hide more money?
I hope you haven't signed anything that makes you the 'responsible' party for the taxes.
Ask for a raise! If you're going to jail, go as a rich man. lol. (Just kidding, RUN!).
This is why I stopped going to those 'Mega' churches. It's all about the money.
the men in black SUVs are probably 'deacons' of the underworld.
The risk of 'accessory after the fact' is very high for you. You need legal immunity.
lol 'God's silent partners.' that pastor has jokes. he should be on Netflix.
Psychological manipulation via scripture is the most effective tool for suppressing dissent in churches.
Check the 'special projects' fund. That’s where the real bodies are buried.
I found a ledger with names of politicians. I’m shaking. I’m in the office now.
GET OUT OF THE OFFICE NOW. Don't take the ledger, just take photos of it.
Politicians? Bro, you are in the deep end. This is not just a cartel, it's a 'System.'
If you are caught with those photos, you are finished. Be careful.
The lion is hungry. Don't be the meat.
use a 'burner' phone to send the photos to a trusted journalist abroad.
The FATF (Financial Action Task Force) would be very interested in this case.
no cap, some of these churches are just 'Bureau de Change' with a choir. lol.
The 'moral hazard' of being an accountant in Nigeria is extreme.
Lagos Lekki churches are basically country clubs for the elite.
Do they have a 'Private Jet' yet? That's the next step for laundered money.
I’m praying for your safety. This is a nightmare.
Justice will be served, but make sure you are alive to see it.
Delete this thread once you've read everything. They might be monitoring your internet.
Good luck, bro. Iyana Ipaja is a good place to hide. lol.
if you reach a safe place, let us know with a 'star' emoji. don't say where you are.
The Lord is your shepherd! He will guide you through the valley.
imagine if the 'Silent Partners' are actually just very shy billionaires lol. (Unlikely).
The 'God' defense is the ultimate shield against auditing in West Africa.
I bet the Pastor’s wife has 500 designer bags. That’s where the 50m goes.
Is there a 'Miracle' fund? That's usually the most suspicious one.
Stay vigilant. The devil is in the details.
I'm following this. This is the biggest story on WhisprSpace yet.
Don't be a martyr for a fake God.
⭐ (I'm safe for now. Thanks everyone. I'm moving tonight.)

title: My 'Aso-Ebi' for my best friend’s wedding cost 150k but the reception food was only 'Jollof and one dry meat.'
content: I am beyond vexed. I spent 150k on the lace, 20k for makeup, and 15k for Gele. I was expecting a five-course meal at a 5-star hotel in Victoria Island. When it was time to eat, they served us Jollof rice that tasted like it was cooked yesterday and one piece of chicken that was harder than a landlord's heart. I saw the bride’s family eating small chops and grilled fish in a private room. Is it wrong to send her an invoice for my 'distress'?

replies.content: 150k for a 'single' portion of dry rice? that's a 'wedding tax' scam lol. don't send an invoice, just don't go to the baby shower.
bruh, 'harder than a landlord's heart' is the best description of wedding chicken ever. no cap, the family always eats better.
This is 'Social Capital Exploitation.' The couple used the Aso-Ebi sales to fund the hall, not the catering.
Lagos weddings are just high-fashion hunger strikes. Always eat at home before you go.
Oh dear, 150k is a lot! But please, don't ruin the friendship over food. It’s her big day.
I did the same for a 200k lace. They served us 'Eba and Egusi' in a bowl. I almost cried in my makeup.
If you see 'Family Only' private rooms at a wedding, just know the general guests are in trouble.
Is the lace at least high quality? Maybe you can sew something else with it for Christmas.
Be thankful for the life of the couple. Food is temporary, marriage is forever (hopefully).
A stomach can be empty, but a beautiful photo lasts forever. Focus on the 'vibes.'
if you send an invoice, make sure you add 'GST' for the sweat from the Gele lol.
lol 'distress invoice.' i love it. 'Item 1: Hunger (50k).'
The 'As-Ebi economy' is a fascinating study in peer-pressured luxury spending.
Actually, charging for Aso-Ebi to pay for the wedding is quite common in Nigeria. You were a sponsor.
This is why I stopped buying Aso-Ebi. I’ll wear my old clothes and eat my own food.
The bride just called to ask why I didn't post the wedding on my IG. I told her I was too weak from hunger.
savage! lol. tell her to 'soft launch' the food next time.
Lagos vendors will humble you. They probably collected 1M for food and gave 100k value.
Did you at least get a souvenir? Hope it wasn't a plastic bowl.
I got a notebook and a pen for a 50k Aso-Ebi. I used the pen to write my 'will' lol.
The disconnect between 'Visual Splendor' and 'Hospitality Reality' is a major issue in Nigerian events.
bruh, imagine paying 150k and you're still fighting for a bottle of water in the hall.
Always check the 'Caterer' on the invitation before buying the cloth.
I hope the Jollof was at least 'party' Jollof and not 'concoction' rice.
Party Jollof is only good when there's dodo and moin-moin. Plain Jollof is an insult.
if the bride gets angry, ask her for a refund on the 'extra' lace you didn't use.
Let it go, dear. Peace is better than a full stomach.
Co-dependency in friendships often manifests through these expensive 'rituals.'
no cap, the dry meat is probably because the server's 'Aunty' took the good parts home.
Internalized theft by catering staff is a standard overhead cost in Lagos.
I once saw a caterer putting whole chickens into her handbag. The struggle is real.
Did you get a 'takeaway' pack? That's the only way to recover some of that 150k.
No takeaway! They said 'food has finished' at 4 PM. In a hall of 500 people!
That means they only catered for 200. Classic 'budget' wedding.
God will provide a better meal for you tomorrow. Don't worry.
Lagos is the only place where you pay to be a 'spectator' of someone's joy.
I’m hungry just reading this. Go to a buka and buy some real food.
